Connect the number you use in the WhatsApp Business app (version 2.24.17 or newer) and keep using the app on your phone: its contacts and up to 6 months of chats come into the inbox, and what you send from the phone shows there too. A new number works as well. You connect it in Meta's own window, in a few minutes.
lp.yes-every-payment-for-your-plan: Yes. Every payment for your plan comes with a GST tax invoice as a PDF, for your accounts.
lp.yes-everyone-signs-in-with-their: Yes. Everyone signs in with their own Google account, and you choose their role (admin, agent or viewer) and the pages they can open. You can hide customers' phone numbers from agents, and anyone can switch on 2-step verification with a code on WhatsApp.
lp.yes-the-owner-can-download-all: Yes. The owner can download all the company's data at any time, and delete the company, in Settings → Data & Privacy. See the Privacy Policy.
lp.your-team-replies-from-one-shared: Your team replies from one shared inbox
